results.question: 查询2024年1月21日当天，所有类型的回访发起总量分别是多少？（按类型名称显示）。
results.expected_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN callback_type = 1 THEN '人工回访' WHEN callback_type = 2 THEN '短信回访' WHEN callback_type = 3 THEN '智能语音' END AS 回访类型,SUM(callback_cnt) AS total_initiated FROM item_callback_total_day WHERE busi_time = '2024-01-21' GROUP BY callback_type;
results.generated_sql: SELECT "callback_type", SUM("callback_cnt") AS "total_callback_cnt" FROM "item_callback_total_day" WHERE "busi_time" = '2024-01-21' GROUP BY "callback_type" ORDER BY "callback_type" LIMIT 100
